create_model_from_config: create a Model instance from config, feature config, and metadata using Model.from_config class method
train_batch_forward_pass: run a forward pass on a batch of data using BaseModel.train_batch to compute loss and predictions
save_model_modules: save each sub-module of a PyText model to separate files using BaseModel.save_modules method
quantize_model_for_export: quantize a PyText model using dynamic quantization on Linear and LSTM layers via BaseModel.quantize
create_embedding_modules: create embedding modules from feature config and metadata using Model.create_embedding class method
